glossEn: a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance
note: a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance。在场听看演出的这群人。线索：at a performance / in the hall。合并现有 听众/观众 两义。

glossZh: 读者，观众（某内容的受众）
glossEn: the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment
note: the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment。某份内容的目标受众，不一定到场。线索：target audience / a wide audience。与 s1 的差别是「是否在场」。
